articles.title: Anthropic's long-term leadership in AI looks 'extremely strong': Fmr. Cisco CEO
articles.summary:
JC2 Ventures founder and CEO John Chambers sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) amended prospectus and what that could indicate about the company's leadership in the space, while also commenting on what a "trainwreck" company in the AI ecosystem looks like.

Chambers was executive chairman and CEO of Cisco Systems (CSCO).

articles.title: JPMorgan's shocking capital expenditures estimates for Amazon, and worries for McDonald's ahead
articles.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down all the top headlines of the trading day, including how hyperscalers have gotten "silly cheap," Nvidia's (NVDA) "unbelievable" valuation, and why McDonald's (MCD) earnings should have investors worried.

Sozzi also sits down with the Founder & CEO of JC2 Ventures and Former Cisco Executive Chairman & CEO John Chambers to discuss the current state of the tech market.
